name: ks-autopilot-binding-v2
rule: plain_checks_digest = sha256 over the manifest-canonical JSON (docs/upgrade/vectors/manifest-canonical-v1.json) of the list of {id, sentence} objects in the order listed. The autopilot block's canonical bytes and sha256 are the same canonical form. A block is sound when its digest is the digest of its sentences, its ids are unique and not_checked is not empty.
consumers: the client: ks cruise auto (the vendored copy in its testdata/autopilot)
